content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fairfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential requirements for the PMP®—most candidates need a bachelor's degree plus several years of direct project leadership. Gather your project documentation before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend interactive sessions from your location on a schedule that fits your work and life. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—all required to sit for the credential.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, including education and work history. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. PMI will verify your background; processing typically takes several weeks. Keep all course completion records and correspondence organized for this step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to reinforce core concepts and boost confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE. You may test at a center or via remote proctoring, depending on your preference and location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold the PMP® for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or PMI membership activities. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Fairfield's project-driven employers.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
